evals.prompt: We can't patch CVE-2021-44228 yet — give me Snort and YARA rules we can deploy in the meantime.
evals.expected_output: Rule files written to .vulnetix/detection/CVE-2021-44228/ with per-family rule counts, file paths, and copy-pasteable invocation hints.
expectations: Reads .vulnetix/capabilities.yaml and captures derived.detection_stack to decide which families to fetch
Calls `vulnetix vdb snort-rules list --cve-id CVE-2021-44228 --format rules` writing to .vulnetix/detection/CVE-2021-44228/snort.rules
Calls `vulnetix vdb yara-rules list --cve-id CVE-2021-44228 --format rules` writing to .vulnetix/detection/CVE-2021-44228/vuln.yar
Renders rule count and highest signature severity per family with the on-disk file path
Appends `event: detection-rules` with per-family rule counts to .vulnetix/memory.yaml

evals.prompt: Build me a Nuclei template for CVE-2024-3094 so I can run it against our authorised staging environment.
evals.expected_output: A nuclei.yaml template saved to disk plus a copy-pasteable `nuclei -t ... -u <target>` invocation hint.
expectations: Calls `vulnetix vdb nuclei get CVE-2024-3094 --format yaml` writing to .vulnetix/detection/CVE-2024-3094/nuclei.yaml
Emits the `nuclei -t .vulnetix/detection/CVE-2024-3094/nuclei.yaml -u <target>` invocation hint only if binaries.nuclei is true in capabilities.yaml
Explicitly states the skill writes the template but never executes it — user runs the engine
Skips Snort/YARA sections if those binaries are absent from derived.detection_stack
Updates .vulnetix/memory.yaml with `event: detection-rules` noting Nuclei template count

evals.prompt: No detection tooling is installed locally but I still want the raw IDS rules for CVE-2023-46604 to hand to our SOC team.
evals.expected_output: After confirmation prompt, raw rules fetched for snort/yara/nuclei families and written to .vulnetix/detection/CVE-2023-46604/ without invocation hints.
expectations: Detects empty derived.detection_stack and prompts the user whether to proceed with raw fetch
On user accept, treats the stack as [snort, yara, nuclei] for completeness
Calls `vulnetix vdb traffic-filters CVE-2023-46604` to pull Suricata-compatible Snort filters
Writes snort.rules, vuln.yar, and nuclei.yaml under .vulnetix/detection/CVE-2023-46604/
Omits binary-specific invocation hints (snort -c / yara / nuclei) because no binaries are installed
